issuer: Kolaboro (kolaboro.com), operated by Equinox Investment Group LLC
purpose: Signs answers of the open data API (/api/open/*), the public log and evidence receipts.
signature_format: Header x-kolaboro-signature = base64 Ed25519 signature of the UTF-8 message 'kolaboro-sig-v1\n' + SHA-256 hex of the exact response body; header x-kolaboro-key-id names the key.
signature_format_checkpoint: GET /api/open/checkpoint is a C2SP signed note (origin kolaboro.com/log); key hash = first 4 bytes of SHA-256('kolaboro.com/log' || 0x0A || 0x01 || public key).
signature_format_rekor: Each daily log head is also signed in minisign format (key id F2E04DA5878F8C51, the same Ed25519 key) and recorded in Sigstore Rekor.
rotation: Keys are never reused. A new key is announced here with its valid_from date before it signs anything; the old key gets valid_until and stays listed, so old signatures remain checkable. A compromised key is marked status=revoked with the date from which its signatures must not be trusted.
